recipes.name: Toasted Seasoned Bread Crumbs
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium pan over medium-high heat. Add the panko, spice mix, and salt.
Stir frequently for 4 to 5 minutes, or until the bread crumbs are golden.
Allow to cool completely before storing. Enjoy on your favourite pasta, soups, salads, or casseroles!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.
